name: a link whose text escapes a bracket
why: A backslash before a bracket is an escape a renderer honours and the snapshot's reader cannot see, so the two disagree about where the link text ends and the reader finds no target to check. An escaped bracket is a backslash, and a backslash is refused wherever it appears in a fact's text, so that is the rule this fails on; the escape is pinned against the link reader directly in tests/test_links.py.
